name: Noor-e-Hidayat
description: Complete Islamic application featuring verified Quran (all 114 Surahs and 30 Paras) with ayah-wise translation and Tafseer, Sahih Hadith library, live Makkah and Madinah, prayer times with Azan alerts, Qibla compass, Zakat calculator, Tasbeeh counter, Duas, and four languages (English, Urdu, Arabic, Hindi).
